activity.notes: Toussaint Louverture became governor-general under the 1801 constitution of Saint-Domingue and exercised government until the French expedition forced his surrender in 1802. ATLAS links this office to Saint-Domingue, the polity then occupying present-day Haiti, rather than to the independent state of Haiti created in 1804.
